source_text:
3.21 Ἀφρικανοῦ· περὶ
λυσσοδήκτων καὶ ὑδροφόβων καὶ λοιπῶν δηγμάτων ἑρπετῶν Ὁ παρὼν
ἐγχυματισμὸς διὰ δʹ ἔχει τὴν σύστασιν· γεντιανῆς, σμύρνης, ἀριστολοχείας
στρογγύλης καὶ δαφνίδων. Ταῦτα ἐξ ἴσου κόπτε καὶ σῆθε ἀναλαμβάνων μέλιτι ὠμῷ. Ἡ δόσις κυάμου Αἰγυπτιακοῦ τὸ μέγεθος. ∆ίδου δὲ ὀφιοδήκτοις ἐν ὕδατι,
σκορπιοπλήκτοις ἐν οἴνῳ πρωτείῳ διάτριτον.
pass_a_gloss: 3.21 Of-Africanus: about of-rabid-bitten and of-hydrophobes and remaining bites of-creeping-things. The present drench through-4 has the composition: of-gentian, of-myrrh, of-aristolochia round and of-daphnides. These equally cut and sift taking-up with-honey raw. The dose of-bean Egyptian the size. Give but to-snake-bitten in water, to-scorpion-struck in wine first-rate a-three-day-dose.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: about those bitten by rabid animals and hydrophobes and remaining bites of creeping things. The present drench has its composition through four: gentian, myrrh, round aristolochia, and daphnides. Cut these in equal parts and sift, taking them up with raw honey. The dose is the size of an Egyptian bean.
Give it to those bitten by snakes in water, to those struck by scorpions in first-rate wine, as a three-day dose.

lemmas.gloss: one bitten by a rabid animal

choices.why: δʹ is 4. The lock is the four-ingredient tetrapharmakon (gentian, myrrh, round aristolochia, daphnides). CF crib said two.
κύαμος is a bean. Dose-size of an Egyptian bean is a standard measure. Not κύμινον cumin.
2sg imperative of σήθω. After κόπτε (chop), the powder is sieved, then taken up with raw honey.
δαφνίς is the bay-berry, the fruit used in the tetrapharmakon. Not δάφνη leaves ('laurels').
λύσσα-bitten persons, paired with hydrophobes. Not 'rabid dogs' as the patients.
πρωτεῖος is of the first quality. Not νέος / 'new wine'.
rejected: first wine of the vintage only

choices.why: LSJ τὸ διάτριτον is a medicine given for three days. A third-part reading is possible but the bean-size already gives the quantity.
rejected: a third only, dropping the three-day sense

choices.why: Same veterinary pour-in as elsewhere in book 3. Not a generic mixture or salve.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
